subject: Evaluating a system of equations with MVNORM

messages.author: 9869e52e9a4f7d9a
messages.subject: Evaluating a system of equations with MVNORM
parts:
Hello,

I've been trying to write up a model which has 2 outcomes (call them y1 and y2) which are functions of some fixed effects, and y1 and y2 are correlated (which is what I want to capture). 

We can visualize it like: y1 = a1 + b1*x1 + noise1; y2 = a2 + b2*x2 + noise2; there exists correlation between y1 and y2.

I was wondering if the following cpp code is sort of the kosher way of evaluating this kind of model? Initially I was evaluating the negative log-likelihood by adding the two independent likelihoods just to see how the simulated parameters would be returned, but from what I dug around, having an MVNORM around the residuals (where the residuals are just the Ys minus the respective right hand side fit). 

I'm mostly looking for feedback and suggestions on what would be the better way of evaluating such a multivariate regression system?


Thanks!!


#include <TMB.hpp>
using namespace density;

template<class Type>
  Type objective_function<Type>::operator() ()
{
  DATA_VECTOR(y1);
  DATA_VECTOR(x1);
  DATA_VECTOR(y2);
  DATA_VECTOR(x2);

  PARAMETER(a1);
  PARAMETER(b1);
  PARAMETER(a2);
  PARAMETER(b2);

  // PARAMETER(logSigma1);
  // PARAMETER(logSigma2);

  // vector<Type> nllvec(2);
  // nllvec[0] = -sum(dnorm(y1, a1 + b1*x1, exp(logSigma1), true));
  // nllvec[1] = -sum(dnorm(y2, a2 + b2*x2, exp(logSigma2), true));
  // Type nll0 = nllvec.sum();

  Type nll0 = 0. ;

  PARAMETER_VECTOR(sd);
  PARAMETER(rho);

  matrix<Type> Sigma(2, 2);

  vector<Type> sd_pos = exp(sd);
  Type rho_pos = (1 + exp(rho))/(1 - exp(rho));

  Sigma.row(0) << sd_pos[0]*sd_pos[0],     sd_pos[1]*sd_pos[0]*rho_pos ;
  Sigma.row(1) << sd_pos[0]*sd_pos[1]*rho_pos, sd[1]*sd_pos[1] ;


  matrix<Type> residual(y1.size(), 2);
  for(int row=0; row<y1.size(); row++) {
    residual(row,0) = Type(y1[row] - a1 - b1*x1[row]);
    residual(row,1) = Type(y2[row] - a2 - b2*x2[row]);

  }

  vector<Type> resid(2);

  for(int i=0; i<residual.rows(); i++)    {
    resid = vector<Type>(residual.row(i));
    nll0 += MVNORM(Sigma)(resid);

  }

  REPORT(Sigma);



  return nll0;
  }
